author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices one finger per key, a long-short trotting rhythm, counting down 5 to 1 and matching phrase starts, on a snowy sleigh trip.

classes.title: Five fingers in the sleigh
classes.goal: Place the right hand with one finger on each key, thumb on C.

mathTarget.parentLine: Five fingers, five keys: one finger for each

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child put the thumb on C, then touch each finger to its key, 1 to 5.
classes.childAction: Thumb on C, then one finger on each key up to G.
classes.bridge: Five keys are five seats in the sleigh; each finger gets its own seat.

intro.caption: Everyone into the sleigh!
intro.parentCue: thumb on C, just left of the two black keys

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one finger on each key, 1 to 5.

classes.title: Long-short, like a trot
classes.goal: Play the first line and feel its long-short, long-short trotting rhythm.

mathTarget.parentLine: The long note lasts twice as long as the short one

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'trot-ting, trot-ting', long then short, while your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play the first line: long, short, long, short, like a horse trotting.
classes.bridge: Long-short is the horse's trot: a big step, a little step, over the river.

intro.caption: Trot-ting, trot-ting, off we go
intro.parentCue: say it slowly, long then short

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a long-short rhythm, like a trot.

classes.title: The horse knows the way
classes.goal: Play the second part together; the grown-up plays the high A at the top.

mathTarget.parentLine: The line climbs to its highest note, then comes back down

classes.parentPrompt: Grown-up, you play the high A; your child plays the notes around it.
classes.childAction: Climb up with your fingers; your grown-up plays the top note.
classes.bridge: The tune climbs a snowy hill to the right; the top is the grown-up's.

intro.caption: Up the snowy hill we go
intro.parentCue: you play the high A at the top

games.caption: The horse knows the way
games.parentCue: Lift your hand as the lights climb

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a line climb to its top.

classes.title: Same start, new road
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and hear which lines start the same way.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two lines start alike, then go different ways

classes.parentPrompt: Tap your nose when a line starts with E, E, E; tap your knee for D, D.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and spot the lines that start E, E, E.
classes.bridge: Two roads leave from the same gate on E: one goes home, one climbs.

intro.caption: Which lines start the same?
intro.parentCue: tap your nose for each E, E, E start

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing lines that start the same.

classes.title: Count down to C: 5 to 1
classes.goal: Practise the last line slowly: from G down to C, fingers 5, 4, 3, 2, 1.

mathTarget.parentLine: Fingers 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, in order, all the way down

classes.parentPrompt: Count '5, 4, 3, 2, 1' softly as each finger plays, like a sleigh slowing down.
classes.childAction: Play G down to C, counting fingers 5, 4, 3, 2, 1.
classes.bridge: The sleigh slides down the last hill to the left and stops at C.

intro.caption: Count down: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1
intro.parentCue: count down slowly with your child

games.caption: Slide down: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1
games.parentCue: Count each finger as it plays

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting fingers down from 5 to 1.

classes.title: Snowy road, slow and even
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and evenly, like a careful horse on snow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Every hoofbeat the same distance apart, slow and even

classes.parentPrompt: Pat a slow, even beat on your knee beside your child as they play.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and evenly, step by careful step.
classes.bridge: On snow, the horse walks carefully: even steps, never rushing.

intro.caption: Careful on the snowy road
intro.parentCue: pat a slow beat on your knee

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing slowly and evenly.

classes.title: Same trip, up high
classes.goal: Play the song from a higher C with the same fingers and hear it match.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same song still works when the hand moves up

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child find the next C to the right, by its two black keys.
classes.childAction: Move your hand to the high C and ride again.
classes.bridge: High C is the same road on the other side of the river.

intro.caption: Cross the river to high C
intro.parentCue: find the next two black keys to the right

games.caption: Hear the trip up high
games.parentCue: Ask: does it sound like sleigh bells?

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same song in a higher place.

classes.title: Ride along together
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Fitting your playing to a speed you did not choose

classes.parentPrompt: Pat the trot on your knee beside your child; if notes are missed, keep riding.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes? Keep riding!
classes.bridge: The music is the horse; your fingers ride along in the sleigh.

intro.caption: Hold on, the sleigh is fast!
intro.parentCue: pat the trot on your knee to help

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music.

classes.title: We made it to Grandfather's!
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy and hear the last line arrive home on C.

mathTarget.parentLine: One line stops on D, still travelling; the last lands on C

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; at the last C, say 'we're here!' and bow together.
classes.childAction: Play to the end, land on C, and shout 'We're here!'
classes.bridge: D is still on the road; C is the front door of Grandfather's house.

intro.caption: A trip to play for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a whole song that travels and arrives.
